rationale: The Latin anchors are decisive: *sepes* means a fence or hedge of shrubs/bushes, and the biblical quotation *"exi in vias et sepes"* (Luke 14:23, "go out into the roads and hedgerows") as well as *"destruxisti omnes sepes ejus"* (you have broken down all his hedges) all point unambiguously to a physical, planted boundary structure. This matches hedge.n.01 ("a fence formed by a row of closely planted shrubs or bushes") exactly.
